title: Daily Curiosity Topic Bank
description: Clear, approachable prompts for a few minutes of conversation, journaling, or wondering.

topics.question: Why is it easier to give good advice than to follow it?
angles: Which advice is hardest to take in your own life?
What usually gets in the way?

topics.question: Why do we compare our ordinary days to other people's highlights?
angles: Which app makes that feeling strongest?
What would make the comparison fairer?

topics.question: Why can one song bring back a whole room you have not seen in years?
angles: Which song takes you back fastest?
Does the memory change when you hear it somewhere new?

topics.question: Why do people talk to pets in a different voice?
angles: Do you catch yourself doing it?
Which animal would be the best conversationalist?

topics.question: Why do people laugh at the exact moment they are trying to stay serious?
angles: Have you ever had to fight a laugh?

topics.question: Why can tidying a whole room feel easier than starting one small task?

topics.question: Why can waiting for a reply feel longer than waiting for a bus?

topics.question: Why can a tiny phone notification steal your attention even when the message can wait?

topics.question: Is a rule fair if it is the same for everyone but much harder for some people?
